tool_args.rationale: The initial rows span u_now but have only 0.018 s_grad variation, leaving the coupled siphon parameters and branch underidentified. Acquire the explicitly recommended open_branch_discriminating_probe before fitting across the full fallback parameter range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon with a positive square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows have narrow s_grad span, so vmax and rho are collinear; the branch sign and heterogeneous rho are not identifiable from these rows alone.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon with a negative leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open branch remains unresolved; the available discriminating probe directly adds the needed s_grad leverage.
Pilot s_grad is near 1, below the stated supercritical regime; this probe is not indicated and is not in the available menu.
Neither targets the identified branch/parameter ambiguity as directly as the lower-cost open-branch probe.
